title: Sharplink text reveal
description: Text that assembles itself as you scroll: letters fade in in a scattered order (or brighten from 35%), or words light up one after another, scrubbed with the scroll by a CSS view timeline. Static HTML shows the full text.
notes: CSS scroll-driven animation: browsers without view timelines, and reduced motion, show the text as is
pass `timeline` to follow a named view timeline of a parent (e.g. a pinned stage) instead of the text's own
